steps.python_approach: pd.read_csv(path) (default quotechar '"'), then strip one pair of surrounding single quotes from every object column (s.str.replace(r"^'(.*)'$", r"\1", regex=True)); apply R make.names to headers (no-op here). Keep RangeIndex = raw row position.
df['ClaimNb'] = np.minimum(df['ClaimNb'], 4).astype(float); df['Exposure'] = np.minimum(df['Exposure'], 1.0), in R order.
levels = sorted unique Area strings (A..F); AreaGLM = position in that list + 1 (int).
VehPowerGLM = np.minimum(VehPower, 9) as string; dummies from captured levels ['4'..'9'], reference '4'.
Vectorised lookup array over 0..110 = [1, 2*10, 3*100]; index VehAge (0-based = R row VehAge+1); out-of-range -> NaN. Levels from xlevels ['2','1','3'].

Lookup array over ages 18..100 = [1*3, 2*5, 3*5, 4*10, 5*10, 6*20, 7*30]; index DrivAge-18 (0-based); out-of-range -> NaN. Levels from xlevels ['5','1','2','3','4','6','7']. Kept as-is although age is protected.
Keep the string columns; design dummies '<var><level>' for every captured level except the first (B1, R24, Diesel).
Not implemented. fit() receives the harness-supplied training rows.

steps.r_construct: glm(ClaimNb ~ ..., offset = log(Exposure), family = poisson()) with default glm.control
steps.python_approach: numpy IRLS mirroring glm.fit for poisson(log): mustart = y + 0.1, eta = log(mustart) (offset not subtracted at start, as glm.fit), z = (eta - offset) + (y - mu)/mu, w = sqrt(mu), coef from QR of X*w, eta = X@coef + offset, deviance 2*sum(y*log(y/mu) [0 when y=0] - (y - mu)), stop when |dev - dev_old|/(|dev| + 0.1) < 1e-8, maxit 25; SEs from the last iteration's R factor (dispersion 1). Design columns: '(Intercept)' first, then terms in R model.matrix order.
exp(X_new @ coef + log(Exposure_capped)) using the same design function; the offset is evaluated in newdata as R does. NaN if any design value is NaN.
